method: Bounded CRAG over primary research sources. Literature supports or limits transfer claims; it cannot replace the exact candidate theorems in CAS_CONTRACT.json.

rows.title: TSFC: a structure-preserving form compiler
rows.supported_claim: A high-level weak form can be lowered to scheduled tensor operations while preserving structure long enough for compiler analysis.
rows.uncovered_assumption: It does not validate a relativistic fermionic collision form, finite-m_e shells, entropy, tail semantics, binary64 bounds, or generated consumer coverage.
rows.nearest_counterexample: A compiler can faithfully lower an incomplete or physically incorrect form.
rows.transfer_risk: HIGH if compiler correctness is treated as physics correctness.

rows.title: An Entropy Stable Discontinuous Galerkin Finite-Element Moment Method for the Boltzmann Equation
rows.supported_claim: Renormalized moment closures and suitable DG fluxes can preserve an entropy structure in a classical Boltzmann setting.
rows.uncovered_assumption: The method uses a moment approximation in velocity and DG in physical space; it does not prove the proposed compactified local momentum-cell fermionic reaction operator or a Petrov inf-sup theorem.
rows.nearest_counterexample: Entropy stability of a related closure does not imply entropy stability of a nonsymmetric trial/test mass map.

rows.title: Deterministic Solution of the Boltzmann Equation Using Discontinuous Galerkin Discretizations in the Velocity Space
rows.supported_claim: Velocity-space DG is an executable deterministic family for classical collision operators.
rows.uncovered_assumption: It does not cover the six-species relativistic Fermi-blocked finite-electron-mass weak catalogue or the proposed compactified endpoint theorem.
rows.nearest_counterexample: Its reported high-dimensional collision cost shows that local discretization alone does not satisfy the frozen operation/LOC budget.

rows.title: A fast spectral method for the Uehling-Uhlenbeck equation for quantum gas mixtures
rows.supported_claim: Deterministic methods can preserve conservation to high accuracy for quantum gas-mixture collision operators in their stated setting.
rows.uncovered_assumption: It is not a proof of exact local reaction-DG entropy, compactified tail authority, finite-m_e weak shells, or the B3 non-isomorphism requirement.
rows.nearest_counterexample: A viable quantum spectral method may use a materially different global representation and conservation treatment.

rows.title: The spatially homogeneous Boltzmann equation coupled to the Bianchi I Einstein equations
rows.supported_claim: Anisotropic homogeneous Einstein-Boltzmann systems require careful momentum weights and admit a rigorous continuum analysis under stated assumptions.
rows.uncovered_assumption: Well-posedness is not a numerical convergence, stiffness-spectrum, DG, or DSMC precision theorem for the future RABBIT model.
rows.nearest_counterexample: Continuum existence does not select the discretization or time integrator.
rows.transfer_risk: HIGH if used for solver admission.

rows.title: Neutrino decoupling with a direct simulation Monte Carlo method
rows.supported_claim: DSMC can produce useful homogeneous isotropic neutrino-decoupling estimates with statistical uncertainty.
rows.uncovered_assumption: The isotropic calculation omits the directional stress moments, deterministic covariance, exact Jacobian, and coupled Bianchi feedback required here.
rows.nearest_counterexample: It prevents the false universal claim that neutrino DSMC cannot converge.
rows.transfer_risk: HIGH for endpoint authority; potentially LOW for a separately authorized qualitative cross-check.

rows.title: Propagation of chaos for the Nanbu particle system
rows.supported_claim: Classical homogeneous particle approximations have rigorous convergence results under restricted kernels and time statements.
rows.uncovered_assumption: It does not cover the relativistic, Fermi-blocked, multi-species, anisotropic, dynamically coupled system or a deterministic 1e-10 certificate.
rows.nearest_counterexample: It prevents a blanket claim that all DSMC-family methods lack convergence.

search_conclusion.inference: The retrieved literature supplies adjacent algorithms and cautionary transfer bounds, not the missing candidate-specific admission theorems.
